posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
I was a little surprised I didn't find a thread like this already when I went digging for it. (Maybe we did it on the old forums...)

If you could have a super power, what would it be? Why? How would you use it?

Personally, I'd love to be able to teleport. I really dislike wasting time getting places. I don't like text forms of communications, as they tend to create misunderstandings and other issues, so if I could teleport I could just go to the person and talk, instead. (When it's appropriate and the other person is okay with it, of course. ![](upload://lNCUQFYSA7ZMqVCMtPuFwzz40RT.gif))

First thing I would do is open a delivery service - for folks who really, truly, need it delivered this minute.

I would also make myself available to emergency response teams for situations in which they need to get into a place that they can't physically reach but a person could fit in.

How about you?

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
imprimis5:

Time Control. Period. The ability to speed up, slow down, or even stop time would be perfect and so useful. It even covers my close second of super speed.

I've always thought this power set would be wierd.  Are you immune to your power?  If not stopping time would be rather permanent.  If you are immune it would be wierd, because you would be growing older normally while everyone else wasn't.  You'd want to be immune to your own power and also immortal, which would make you nearly a god.

 

I always liked the Danger Sense powers, one of my favorite M&M characters had that and a tactical ability that let her evaluate anything she looked at in a split second.  Neither the GM nor I realized how broken that combo would be.  If only I had made her an archer. (she was a martial artist, but not a powerful one)

That would be my favorite power set, Parse with Danger sense.

 

My second choice is from a sci-fi campaign with tech based enhancements to humans, I had a crazy inventor who could rebuild things into new things really fast, used to take laser weapons and turn them into force fields and grenades, it was insanely fun.  That kind of character works better in a sci-fi setting than current day.  The mechanics we made up for the power was awesome, streamlined and lots of fun, you could create almost anything you wanted, most of them made up on the spot, and almost all of them would blow up after using them.  I loved that character.

posts.name: Azqa
posts.cooked:
Perfect control of my body down to the cellular level.  By "perfect" I mean that I could control it all consciously but could leave it on auto-pilot when desired.

 

Thus, no lasting diseases or injuries unless I wanted to keep the scars as mementos.  Free plastic surgery.  Whatever physique I felt like having.  Regeneration (speed would be difficult, unless I could adjust biological processes to the point where I could speed up that healing to ridiculous levels) meaning that damage would have to kill me outright to do anything.  Aging would cease to be a factor in my life, and sleep might become a thing I do only if I feel like passing some time in that manner.  There's the potential for shapeshifting over time, possibly even allowing a reconstruction of the body to permit things like functional wings, deep-sea exploration, or photosynthesis.

posts.name: jagarciao
posts.cooked:
As a useful power I would like the power of telelocation, the ability to know where anything is at anytime by just thinking about. Like an instant GPS on anything I want. 

For pure joy I would say flying... I don't think there would be a more ecstatic experience than soaring through the air. I have done skydiving a few times and did crazy bungee jumps and canyon swing while traveling and I don't think there is a more exhilarating experience anywhere. Plus it would make travel abroad so much cheaper!!

I used to like teleportation before, but I am a public transit commuter nowadays and have found the experience to be incredibly grounding and fulfilling. Just the realization that I don't have to get there right now and can just enjoy the journey has made a much more patient and balanced person. 

I like the idea of time control but I don't think it would work, mostly because I don't really think time itself exists as a separate force... but that's a philosophical discussion better left for a long night with a few drinks :)
